question:
The line chart given below shows production of rice by two companies A and B in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07a7937672eb6cc916018fb0f7ed65cf4272f3dc847066b72d59d80317fb409a.png] 

J1 = The average production of rice by A in years L, M and N.

J2 = The production of rice by B in years N, P and Q.

What is the value of (J2/J1)?
solution: **Calculation:** J1 = The average production of rice by A in years L, M and N = (100 + 80 + 60)/3 = 80 J2 = The production of rice by B in years N, P and Q = (100 + 90 + 75) = 265 J2/J1 = 265/80 = 3.31
